Running command: cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3157,"var":"c","code":"if (c != 3 && c != 1 && c != 4) return stbi__err(\"bad component count\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The decoder accepts a 4-component JPEG, which opens the CMYK-style resampling path used by the issue-under-test."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3173,"var":"z->img_comp[i].h","code":"z->img_comp[i].h = (q >> 4);  if (!z->img_comp[i].h || z->img_comp[i].h > 4) return stbi__err(\"bad H\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The patched SOF marker supplies a nonstandard horizontal factor that is still within the decoder's loose bounds."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3184,"var":"v_max","code":"if (z->img_comp[i].v > v_max) v_max = z->img_comp[i].v;","note":"The decoder derives the maximum vertical factor from the attacker-controlled components, so later resampling geometry is based on the malformed file."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3759,"var":"r->hs","code":"r->hs      = z->img_h_max / z->img_comp[k].h;","note":"The crafted 4:1:1:1 layout yields resampling ratios calculated from integer division, creating a fractional-subsampling mismatch between planes."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3769,"var":"r->resample","code":"else if (r->hs == 2 && r->vs == 2) r->resample = z->resample_row_hv_2_kernel;","note":"The decoder routes the malformed component through the 2x2 kernel instead of rejecting the image, exposing the vulnerable resampling logic."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__resample_row_hv_2","line":3361,"var":"out[2*i+1]","code":"out[2*i+1] = stbi__div16(3*c1 + c2 + 8);","note":"The 2x2 resampler writes interpolated output for each input sample; with the attacker-induced geometry mismatch this can overstep the intended row bounds and corrupt memory."}
]
JSON
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json
